name: Merge Jewels
author: Addicting Games
description: Merge Jewels is a free puzzle game. In this strategic clicker game, you will be tasked with the fun job of seeking out and finding like jewels and then positioning them next to each other before merging them. You will be constantly merging all jewels and when you don't see the jewels onscreen that you would wish to merge, you will have the option to spend your time clicking on the mystery box on the side of the screen in order to open it and grab the mystery jewel to add to the spread in the play area. This is a timed game with a high score counter and if you want to make it to the top of the leaderboard you'll have to think fast and perhaps move even faster. Merge Jewels is a fun and addictive puzzle game where the speed at which you click is equal to the things which you might accomplish. Please be brave and click your way to victory as you merge disparate jewels towards victory in this fun and free puzzle clicker.
